acceptance_rows: R1 When cmd_review sets st['milestone']='ACCEPTED' it also sets st['milestone_revision']=st['parent_hash'], and every st['reviews'] entry records 'revision'.

R2 cmd_replan, when it writes any new PENDING card, sets st['milestone']='REPLANNED' and clears st['milestone_revision']; accepting a card in cmd_review (parent_hash change) also clears st['milestone_revision'] and sets st['milestone'] to 'REPLANNED' if it was 'ACCEPTED'.

R3 cmd_handoff prints MILESTONE VERDICT: ACCEPTED only when st['milestone']=='ACCEPTED' and st['milestone_revision']==st['parent_hash']; otherwise it prints MILESTONE VERDICT: INCOMPLETE with reason MILESTONE_STALE and the current REVISION.

R4 run_e2e.py gains scenario O47: milestone reviewed ACCEPTED; review --subject with findings; replan adds a card; run-card and review --card accepted; handoff must print INCOMPLETE with MILESTONE_STALE; a subsequent milestone review ACCEPTED on the new parent makes handoff print ACCEPTED with REVISION equal to the new parent_hash.
objective: Bind milestone acceptance to a revision so handoff cannot report ACCEPTED for a parent that was never final-reviewed (F3)
stop_condition: print CARD_BLOCKED C4 if scenario id O47 already exists in e2e/run_e2e.py, or if cmd_handoff does not derive its verdict from st['milestone'] as quoted in the finding
